content: Steam: dragonruby-publish turnkey SteamPipe upload is Indie/Pro only (needs steam_metadata.txt, depots win/mac/linux, steamcmd). Standard can still ship via Steamworks toolchain manually. No built-in achievements/cloud API; Steamworks needs C extension (Indie/Pro) - only sample wraps Init + GetUserName, macOS build script. itch: dragonruby-publish uses devid/gameid; Standard OK. Mac notarization/signing handling unknown.
